annotations.title: Get an employment attorney's case track record

description: Given an employment attorney name (or profile slug), return the federal employment-law cases on file in which that attorney appeared — case caption, court, year, nature-of-suit, and the side they appeared for when on record. Use this when a user names an attorney and wants their public litigation history. Facts only, sourced from federal court dockets. Attorney identities are algorithmically matched; ambiguous and lower-confidence matches are excluded. One case is one normalized court+docket number, so duplicate source rows do not inflate the count.

attorney.description: Employment attorney full name (e.g. "Jane Doe") or their workers-rights.com profile slug.

limit.description: Number of example cases to return (1–25). Counts reflect all cases on file, not just these.

name: get_attorney_track_record

_attribution.description: Source and disclaimer for this result: Workers' Rights, its URL, the attribution line, and that the result is educational information, not legal advice.

asDefenseCounsel.description: Cases where the attorney appeared for the employer.

asPlaintiffCounsel.description: Cases where the attorney appeared for the worker.

attorney.description: The attorney name looked up or matched.

cases.description: Matched cases with court, date, nature of suit and side.

courtRecordRepresentation.description: Note when court records show mostly one side.

directory_paused.description: True when the attorney directory is paused.

found.description: Whether the attorney is in the directory.

sideKnown.description: Cases whose side is known from the court record.

years.description: Years spanned by the matched cases.
